hook: A 13-billion-parameter model squeezed under one gigabyte

beats.say: LittleBit is a new framework for extreme compression of large language models, using latent factorization to quantize weights down to just 0.1 bits each while keeping the model usable.
That is roughly a 31-times memory reduction, compressing the 13-billion-parameter Llama2 model to under 0.9 gigabytes.
It also unlocks a potential 11.6-times inference speedup over FP16, making powerful models practical even in resource-constrained settings.
